name: Blur Text
description: Animated text that resolves from blur into focus word by word or letter by letter, with five entrance effects, configurable stagger order, triggers, looping and hover focus.
contents: Paragraph of text split into words or characters, each animated separately
Screen reader only copy of the full text
behavior: Each piece animates from blurred and transparent to sharp with a staggered delay
Starts on scroll into view, on load, on hover or on click depending on trigger
Hover and click triggers replay the animation by running an exit then re-entry
Optional loop plays exit and entry repeatedly after loopDelay seconds
Optional color tint transitions from fromColor to the final color
Optional focusOnHover blurs and dims the other words while one word is hovered
Respects the user reduced motion setting
editableByProps: Text, split mode (words or letters), class names and text color
Effect style, direction, blur amount, travel distance, step duration and stagger delay
Stagger order, trigger, looping and loop delay
Custom start and end keyframes with easing, start color tint, hover focus, completion callback

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the spring bounce or settle feel of an effect
needsCodeEdit.where: buildEffect function, bounce and settle fields

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the dimming strength of focusOnHover

fixed: Requires the motion package and Tailwind CSS classes (flex, inline-flex, sr-only, will-change)
Pieces are aria-hidden with a sr-only copy of the text for accessibility
Uses an IntersectionObserver when trigger is view
Hover trigger replays only after the animation has settled
Exit animation duration is 1.3 times stepDuration with stagger 0.4 times the entry stagger
Random stagger order is deterministic from the text
When animationFrom, animationTo or easing is passed, the built in effect keyframes are replaced
direction only affects which axis and side the effect uses, and drift only distinguishes left from the others

options.look: Text slides in from the chosen direction while sharpening from blur, with a light bounce
options.useWhen: Default hero headline reveal on page load or scroll

options.look: Text scales down from large and blurred into place with a small overshoot
options.useWhen: Bold statement or product name that should land with impact

options.look: Text flips in with 3D rotation and blur, pivoting at an edge
options.useWhen: Playful section titles on creative or portfolio pages

options.look: Text stays in place and simply sharpens from a soft, enlarged blur with no movement
options.useWhen: Calm taglines or long intro paragraphs where motion should stay subtle

options.look: Text glides in sideways with a skew that straightens out while unblurring
options.useWhen: Fast, kinetic headlines on landing pages or banners
